decisions.reason: As a classic Christmas pyramid close to the firm's craft core, it still fits the assortment well, though its absence from later website observations suggests somewhat lower priority than at launch.

With the electronic music-box concept no longer central and the product not seen on the website afterward, this accessory sits too far from the firm's durable handcrafted core to justify continued resources.

The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds on the firm's strongest seasonal capabilities, but its more specific motif and weaker later visibility make it somewhat more exposed than a standard core item.
